intro_html: Bright, fresh, and creamy, these bowls bring a little Mediterranean sunshine to your meal prep. You get 51 grams of protein per serving for about $4.98 (at everyday cost), which is a great price for eating this well. One skillet makes 14 servings.
cost_closing_html: About $4.98 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 bowls delivers 51 grams of protein and about 581 calories.
upsell_html: Light on the wallet, big on flavor, and it keeps beautifully all week. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: The 7 lb ground turkey pack keeps your cost per serving low, so buy the big size.
A tub of plain Greek yogurt doubles as your creamy topping and a protein boost, so buy it instead of pricey tzatziki.
Fresh zucchini under a dollar each stretches the pan and adds real veggie volume for almost nothing.
make_it: Heat a little olive oil in a large skillet and brown the ground turkey.
Add the chopped onion and sliced zucchini and cook until tender.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and let it simmer a few minutes to come together.
Season with salt, pepper, and whatever dried herbs you like, then take it off the heat.
Serve over cooked white rice with a big dollop of Greek yogurt on top.

head.description: A high-protein Mediterranean meal prep. Fourteen servings at about 581 calories and 51 grams of protein for roughly $4.98 each (at everyday cost).
